quest.title: Ardent Land of Plenty
quest.description: As you arrive at the outskirts of the Great Volcano of Tollan, you come across a young girl by the roadside...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x350, Mora x26025, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x6

talks.objective: Talk to the girl by the side of the road

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, we know that name! So, that's you!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Well, this is {NICKNAME}, and Paimon's Paimon, {M#his}{F#her} awesome travel companion.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME} and Paimon... Now, that has a nice ring to it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright! Let's get going!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh... What's this wooden plank doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Oh, it's a piece of training equipment! I use it all the time.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Training equipment?

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Yeah! It's kinda hard to explain... Lemme show you instead. Here goes nothin'!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: And she sticks the landing!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, you jumped over that huge gap just like that? Incredible!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Oh, no, no! Anyone can do it with a bit of practice.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: You made it across without any training at all. That's a lot more incredible than anything I can do.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, well, Paimon can fly, but... You've got a point!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Well, this is {NICKNAME}, and Paimon's Paimon, {M#his}{F#her} awesome travel companion.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME} and Paimon... Now, that has a nice ring to it! I won't forget!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright! Let's get going!

talks.objective: Follow the path and continue onward

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hello there! Um...
Hm?
Oh, are you lost? Need some help?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Not lost... exactly. We're on our way to the Collective of Plenty. Is this the right direction?
Yep! That's my home tribe, actually. I can take you the rest of the way, if you want.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Score! Another local guide! We really lucked out!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And, here, I thought that was your job...
A guide, huh... Yeah, sure! Why not? Hehe, from now on, I'll be your guide!
There's a lot of cool scenery around here, actually. I can point it out along the way. It always leaves people in awe!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, that's so nice! But, um... We're not keeping you from anything, are we? You really don't have to go out of your way...
Oh no, not at all! I was just doing some training, but I'm all done for the day. So, I'm heading in that direction, too.
Plus, I can teach you all about the tribe. Besides, learning new things is always fun, right?
As long as you're happy, I'm happy. That's how Uncle Acatl teaches us to treat our guests.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A—Alright...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: She seems super friendly and welcoming.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yeah, we lucked out.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Definitely! Paimon really likes her.
All good over there? Then, let's head out!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, wait! We still don't know your name.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Ah, right! The name's Varesa. Nice to meet you!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hello there! Um...
Hm?
#Wait, you're... {NICKNAME} and Paimon! I've been waiting for you!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! You know us? Huh, we've really made a name for ourselves...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, but... Did we even tell anyone we were coming to the Collective of Plenty?
Oh, you didn't know? Coach Iansan said she invited you to our tribe, so I came out here to wait for you while I did some training.
And now, you're actually here... Hehe, I can't believe it! This is great!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: S—Surely we're not THAT big of a deal...
You're the heroes who defeated the Abyss! You're a huge deal to everyone in Natlan! I've heard the story of "Tum{RUBY#[S]Hope}aini!" so many times, I can practically recite it by heart!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: I've been so excited to meet you ever since Coach Iansan told me you might be coming. Oh, my name's Varesa, by the way. Not sure if Coach mentioned me before...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh yeah, the name sounds familiar!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: During the Abyss invasion, we asked Iansan if the Collective of Plenty needed any help, but she said that Varesa had it all under control.

choices.text: Which means, you must be an impressive warrior yourself.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Not really. It was all Uncle Acatl! All I did was clear out a few monsters.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Just thinking about the invasion gives me chills even now...

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: But, that's in the past. The Collective of Plenty fared pretty well, all things considered. We finished our repairs, so now it's just a matter of helping out the other tribes.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Hehe, c'mon! I'll take you to our camp!

choices.text: And a hero in your own right.

talks.objective: Continue onward to the Collective of Plenty

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Ah, home sweet home! We made it! Welcome to the Collective of Plenty!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, this place is so cool! That platform shaped like the head of a bull is awesome!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Hehe, that's the Resonating Arena! It's where we hold all our competitions.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thanks for bringing us here.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Don't mention it! It was no trouble at all.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: I wish I could show you around, but I need to get home.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, did you remember something important? You really hit the ground running when we ran into those hilichurls back there...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hope we didn't hold you up.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Oh no, not at all! We made it in time! There's just something important I have to do... The most important thing after training — the post-workout meal!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Otherwise, I'll be a lethargic, dizzy, hunger-addled mess. The perils of an empty stomach... It's terrible.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Anyway, I'm sorry, but I've gotta get some food in me... like yesterday! You should grab something, too!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: We can meet back up at the arena! See you soon!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And, she's off...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, talk about whiplash... One second she's chill and laid-back, and the next she's charging head-first into danger... literally!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's the spirit of youth.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The spirit of youth? Sure, whatever you say, old-timer... Paimon thinks we're still young!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Anyway, why don't we take a look around in the meantime? We can head to the arena in a little bit.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The view must be amazing from up there!
